note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Page title bar -- renders: 'Recent changes' heading and help link
Right sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Tools' menu and page tools dropdown
Appearance settings panel -- renders: 'Appearance' label, font size options (Small/Medium/Large), width options, theme options (OS/Day/Night)
Recent changes top links -- renders: 'Show only' toggle and filter controls
Filter tag multiselect widget -- renders: 'Filters' label, show/hide button, and fixed filter categories (New pages, Minor edits, etc.)
Changes list legend -- renders: fixed labels for edit types (Wikibase, Damaging, New page, Minor, Bot, +/- bytes, Watchlist expiry)
Footer -- renders: Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact, Legal, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation and MediaWiki logos
